note: Red-case classes a human critic flags on marketing pages (2026-10-29 production sweep, 124 findings over 33 routes). Each class lists its deterministic DOM/CSS detectors (scripts/invariants/marketing-critic/detectors.mjs) or the judge that must cover it. Detectors run warn-only on marketing PRs until scripts/invariants/marketing-critic/calibrate.mjs shows they meet the floors in marketing-critic.config.json.

classes.title: Colour or motion used as wallpaper
classes.statement: Backgrounds stay matte near-black. Saturated colour, animated canvas or looping video behind content is wallpaper, not an accent.

classes.title: Hero has no single focal point
classes.statement: Each hero has one dominant subject; competing visuals or a text-only void fail.

classes.title: Unbalanced empty space
classes.statement: No band of empty page taller than half a viewport between content blocks.

classes.title: Product mockup at the wrong scale
classes.statement: Product shots are legible: neither a thumbnail-sized frame nor an oversized crop.

classes.title: Text over artwork that already has text
classes.statement: Never print a title over cover art that already shows the title; square art, caption below.

classes.title: Decorative icon tiles
classes.statement: No small icon on a coloured or bordered square heading each card.

classes.title: Step numbering
classes.statement: No 'Step 1' or '01 02 03' numbering on marketing sections.

classes.title: Noisy form
classes.statement: Forms ask for one thing with one primary action; no stacked helper lines or duplicate actions.

classes.title: Filler cards
classes.statement: No stat or benefit cards that describe the page instead of showing the product.

classes.title: Repeated titles and calls to action
classes.statement: A heading appears once per page, and one call to action is not repeated in every section.

classes.title: Dead end
classes.statement: No touch-only instructions on desktop (haptic, tap, swipe) and no 'coming soon' promises or controls that lead nowhere.

classes.title: Square focus ring on a rounded control
classes.statement: The keyboard focus ring follows the shape of the control it marks.

classes.title: All-caps eyebrow label
classes.statement: No small all-caps or letter-spaced label above a heading.

classes.title: Stale or impossible data
classes.statement: Sample data in mockups is current and plausible (dates, counts, release names).

classes.title: Cookie banner covers content
classes.statement: The consent banner never covers a heading, call to action or product shot in the first viewport.

detectors.description: Visible 'Step N' text, or two or more short numerals such as '01'/'02' or '1. Identify' headings, inside main.
At viewports >= 1024px, visible copy that tells the reader to tap, swipe, pinch or feel a haptic.
Visible 'coming soon', 'available soon' or 'not available yet' copy inside main.
A canvas, or a muted looping video without controls, covering >= 20% of the first two viewports.
An element at least half the viewport wide and 200px tall whose computed background uses a saturated colour stop (HSL s >= 0.45 or OKLCH chroma >= 0.1, alpha >= 0.25).
More than the configured share of first-viewport pixels are saturated (HSV s >= 0.5, v >= 0.3).
Short all-caps or uppercase-transformed, letter-spaced label directly above an h1-h3.
Three or more 24-72px square boxes with a fill or border that hold only an icon, outside buttons and links.
On keyboard focus, an unrounded element draws an outline while the borderless field sits in a rounded wrapper.
A fixed cookie banner covers >= 20% of a heading, call to action or image in the first viewport.
The same h1-h3 text appears twice, or the same multi-word call to action four or more times, inside main.
A vertical band inside main, between the first and last content, with no visible content and taller than max(360px, 0.5 x viewport height).
